# `<sl-avatar>` — Avatar

> **Customized in Saipem DS.** It differs from upstream Shoelace: new attribute `size` ('small' | 'medium' | 'large'); new attribute `variant` ('primary' | 'accent' | 'success' | 'neutral' | 'warning' | 'danger' | ''). Use only the API below.

Avatars are used to represent a person or object.

**Status:** stable · **Since:** 2.0

**Import:** `import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/avatar/avatar.js';`

**Uses internally (registered automatically):** `<sl-icon>`

## Attributes

Every attribute is also a property (camelCase name in the second column when it differs). Boolean attributes are on when present: never write `="false"`, remove the attribute or bind the property instead.

| Attribute | Property | Type / allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `image` | — | `string` | `''` | The image source to use for the avatar. |
| `label` | — | `string` | `''` | A label to use to describe the avatar to assistive devices. |
| `initials` | — | `string` | `''` | Initials to use as a fallback when no image is available (1-2 characters max recommended). |
| `loading` | — | `eager`, `lazy` | `'eager'` | Indicates how the browser should load the image. |
| `size` | — | `small`, `medium`, `large` | — | The avatar's size: `small` (1.5rem), `medium` (2.25rem) or `large` (3rem). When omitted, the avatar follows the size set by its container (e.g. a header item), or `large`. |
| `shape` | — | `circle`, `square`, `rounded` | `'circle'` | The shape of the avatar. |
| `variant` | — | `primary`, `accent`, `success`, `neutral`, `warning`, `danger`, `''` | `''` | Tinted colour scheme: a light background with an icon or initials in the variant colour (e.g. the icon tile of a work-area card). Leave empty for the default solid neutral avatar. |

## Events

Listen with `addEventListener`, `(event-name)` in Angular or `@event-name` in Lit. Data is on `event.detail`.

| Event | `event.detail` | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sl-error` | — | The image could not be loaded. This may because of an invalid URL, a temporary network condition, or some unknown cause. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `icon` | The default icon to use when no image or initials are present. Works best with `<sl-icon>`. |

## CSS parts

Parts exist for fine adjustments. Do not use them to change colours, borders or fonts: a missing look is a missing variant of the DS.

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `base` | The component's base wrapper. |
| `icon` | The container that wraps the avatar's icon. |
| `initials` | The container that wraps the avatar's initials. |
| `image` | The avatar image. Only shown when the `image` attribute is set. |

## CSS custom properties

| Property | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--size` | — | The size of the avatar. Overrides `size`. Without either, it follows the inherited `--sl-avatar-size` (set by components such as header item and comment), or 3rem. |

## Documentation and examples

By default, a generic icon will be shown. You can personalize avatars by adding custom icons, initials, and images. You should always provide a `label` for assistive devices.

```html
<sl-avatar label="User avatar"></sl-avatar>
```

```ts
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/avatar/avatar.js';
import { Component, CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA } from '@angular/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-avatar-example',
  schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA],
  template: `<sl-avatar label="User avatar"></sl-avatar>`
})
export class AvatarExampleComponent {}
```

## Examples

### Variants

Use `variant` for a tinted avatar — a light background with the icon or initials in the variant colour — for example
the icon tile of a work-area card.

```html
<sl-avatar shape="rounded" variant="primary" label="Project Management"><sl-icon slot="icon" name="briefcase"></sl-icon></sl-avatar>
<sl-avatar shape="rounded" variant="neutral" label="Equipment Database"><sl-icon slot="icon" name="gear"></sl-icon></sl-avatar>
<sl-avatar variant="success" initials="UC" label="user_cosy_admin"></sl-avatar>
```

### Images

To use an image for the avatar, set the `image` and `label` attributes. This will take priority and be shown over initials and icons.
Avatar images can be lazily loaded by setting the `loading` attribute to `lazy`.

```html
<sl-avatar
  image="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1529778873920-4da4926a72c2?ixlib=rb-1.2.1&auto=format&fit=crop&w=300&q=80"
  label="Avatar of a gray tabby kitten looking down"
></sl-avatar>
<sl-avatar
  image="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1591871937573-74dbba515c4c?ixlib=rb-1.2.1&auto=format&fit=crop&w=300&q=80"
  label="Avatar of a white and grey kitten on grey textile"
  loading="lazy"
></sl-avatar>
```

### Initials

When you don't have an image to use, you can set the `initials` attribute to show something more personalized than an icon.

```html
<sl-avatar initials="SL" label="Avatar with initials: SL"></sl-avatar>
```

### Custom Icons

When no image or initials are set, an icon will be shown. The default avatar shows a generic "user" icon, but you can customize this with the `icon` slot.

```html
<sl-avatar label="Avatar with an image icon">
  <sl-icon slot="icon" name="image"></sl-icon>
</sl-avatar>

<sl-avatar label="Avatar with an archive icon">
  <sl-icon slot="icon" name="archive"></sl-icon>
</sl-avatar>

<sl-avatar label="Avatar with a briefcase icon">
  <sl-icon slot="icon" name="briefcase"></sl-icon>
</sl-avatar>
```

### Sizes

Use the `size` attribute to change an avatar's size. Without it, the avatar follows the size set by its container
(e.g. [header item](header-item.md) and [comment](comment.md)), or `large`. For any other size, set
the `--size` custom property.

```html
<sl-avatar size="small" initials="MR" label="Small avatar"></sl-avatar>
<sl-avatar size="medium" initials="MR" label="Medium avatar"></sl-avatar>
<sl-avatar size="large" initials="MR" label="Large avatar"></sl-avatar>
```

### Shapes

Avatars can be shaped using the `shape` attribute.

```html
<sl-avatar shape="square" label="Square avatar"></sl-avatar>
<sl-avatar shape="rounded" label="Rounded avatar"></sl-avatar>
<sl-avatar shape="circle" label="Circle avatar"></sl-avatar>
```

### Avatar Groups

You can group avatars with a few lines of CSS.

```html
<div class="avatar-group">
  <sl-avatar
    image="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1490150028299-bf57d78394e0?ixid=MXwxMjA3fDB8MHxwaG90by1wYWdlfHx8fGVufDB8fHw%3D&ixlib=rb-1.2.1&auto=format&fit=crop&w=256&h=256&q=80&crop=right"
    label="Avatar 1 of 4"
  ></sl-avatar>

  <sl-avatar
    image="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1503454537195-1dcabb73ffb9?ixid=MXwxMjA3fDB8MHxwaG90by1wYWdlfHx8fGVufDB8fHw%3D&ixlib=rb-1.2.1&auto=format&fit=crop&w=256&h=256&crop=left&q=80"
    label="Avatar 2 of 4"
  ></sl-avatar>

  <sl-avatar
    image="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1456439663599-95b042d50252?ixid=MXwxMjA3fDB8MHxwaG90by1wYWdlfHx8fGVufDB8fHw%3D&ixlib=rb-1.2.1&auto=format&fit=crop&w=256&h=256&crop=left&q=80"
    label="Avatar 3 of 4"
  ></sl-avatar>

  <sl-avatar
    image="https://images.unsplash.com/flagged/photo-1554078875-e37cb8b0e27d?ixid=MXwxMjA3fDB8MHxwaG90by1wYWdlfHx8fGVufDB8fHw%3D&ixlib=rb-1.2.1&auto=format&fit=crop&w=256&h=256&crop=top&q=80"
    label="Avatar 4 of 4"
  ></sl-avatar>
</div>

<style>
  .avatar-group sl-avatar:not(:first-of-type) {
    margin-left: -1rem;
  }

  .avatar-group sl-avatar::part(base) {
    border: solid 2px var(--sl-color-neutral-0);
  }
</style>
```
